'''Chop Harlison''', along with his younger brother, [[Roy Harlison|Roy]], were orphans who lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Shesharile 5]]. After their parents were killed by a [[Swoop gang/Legends|swoop gang]] in their home in [[Gallisport]], Harlison was forced to drop out of school without any funding. Having nearly completed his degree in advanced [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]] design, he was able to join the [[Rabid Mynocks]] as a mechanic. Once he developed the prototype swoop known as the [[Star Slinger]], his designs became coveted by rival gangs, the [[Spiders]] and the [[Raging Banthas]]. Marrying [[Sharda]], the couple had a daughter named [[Jardra]]. After her daughter's birth, Shadra was killed by the Spiders; Harlison took in a young orphan named [[Bobi]], another victim of the violent gangs of Gallisport.

Chop Harlison was present at [[docking bay 1831]] on Gallisport with [[Dutan Lee]] to meet [[Shamus Falconi]] and [[Grasheel]]. He observed Grasheel give the signal that they were being watched but to stay calm by smoking a [[Cigarra/Legends|cigarillo]]. He greeted the [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] as he disembarked the ''[[Lumrunner]]''. After [[Imperial Office of Customs/Legends|Imperial Customs officer]] [[Alijah Orr]] failed to find any contraband, Harlison took possession of [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna gas]] that had been smuggled in [[Lum/Legends|lum]] bottles and military-grade [[Repulsor coil/Legends|repulsorlift coils]].<ref name="AJ9">{{JournalCite|9|Lumrunners}}</ref>
